name: Human Impact
definition: Human Impact is a combination of Safety and Mission impacts.

values.name: Low
values.definition: Safety Impact:(Negligible OR Marginal) AND Mission Impact:(Degraded OR MEF Support Crippled)

values.name: Medium
values.definition: (Safety Impact:(Negligible OR Marginal) AND Mission Impact:MEF Failure) OR (Safety Impact:Critical AND Mission Impact:Degraded)

values.name: High
values.definition: Safety Impact:Critical AND Mission Impact:(MEF Support Crippled OR MEF Failure)

values.name: Very High
values.definition: Safety Impact:Catastrophic OR Mission Impact:Mission Failure
